mocha-mate.title: Mocha Mate | Men's Leather Bifold Wallet with Button Pocket
mocha-mate.descriptionHtml:
A best-seller for a simple reason: it carries more than a card-only slim. The Mocha Mate is a genuine cow leather bifold with an outer button-closure pocket on the back for small essentials — the practical everyday wallet for those who want more than a card-only slim.

  • 100% genuine cow leather
  • ID window for quick access
  • 5–6 card slots + spacious cash pocket
  • Outer button-closure pocket for small essentials

Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — organised carry, small essentials included.

the-truckkr-bi-fold.title: The Truckkr | Men's Crazy Horse Leather Bifold Wallet with Zip Pocket
the-truckkr-bi-fold.descriptionHtml:
A bifold that zips. The Truckkr is handcrafted from genuine crazy horse cow leather with an external zipper compartment — secure small-item storage that standard bifolds skip — alongside dedicated card and cash slots.

  • 100% genuine crazy horse cow leather
  • External zip compartment for small items
  • Dedicated card and cash compartments
  • Compact slim design — develops a unique patina

Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — rugged leather, secure carry.

rfid-protected-kodo-smart-wallet.title: KODO | RFID Smart Wallet for Men
rfid-protected-kodo-smart-wallet.descriptionHtml: Pakistan's First RFID Protected  Smart Leather Wallet Designed & Crafted Solely by KORDOVAN! Made in Top Grain Cow Leather , redefining the beauty of this product.  Features: Two layers of bonded premium full-grain leather High quality elastic Comfortably Holds up to 10 cards 3 Separate Sections for Cards, ID, Cash 1 pocket with pull tab Extremely slim Lightweight Functional – holds all you need Fashionable, trendy, and stylish Easy to keep and carry Handcrafted in Pakistan

tri-fold-premium-durable-belt.title: Tri-Fold Premium Durable Leather Belt
tri-fold-premium-durable-belt.descriptionHtml:
The Tri-Fold belt is made with premium cow leather folded thrice to form a durable bond between each layer.
(ALL BELTS ARE FREE SIZE WHICH MEANS THEY CAN BE CUT DOWN AND SCREWED BACK TO FIT ANY SIZE)

the-elite-mobile-wallet-unisex.title: The Elite | Leather Mobile Wallet for Men & Women
the-elite-mobile-wallet-unisex.descriptionHtml:
"The Elite" Mobile Wallet is a genuine nappa leather long wallet handcrafted by Kordovan, designed to hold a smartphone alongside cards and cash.Features:
100% genuine nappa leather
12 credit/debit card slots
1 ID window
2 cash slots
Dedicated mobile phone chamber
Measures 7.3"L x 3.7"W x 0.6"D
The built-in phone chamber sets this apart from Kordovan's standard long wallets, combining phone and wallet into a single carry.

crazy-horse-long-wallet-unisex-kordovan-.title: Crazy Horse Long | Men's Leather Long Wallet
crazy-horse-long-wallet-unisex-kordovan-.descriptionHtml:
The Crazy Horse Long Wallet is a genuine Crazy Horse cowhide leather wallet handcrafted by Kordovan, featuring a rustic brown finish with naturally occurring scuffs and marks.Features:
100% genuine cow leather
11 credit/debit card slots
1 ID window
2 full-size bill compartments
Measures 7.5"L x 3.8"W
The long-format design and higher card capacity make this a better fit than Kordovan's bi-fold wallets for those who carry more cards and full-size bills unfolded.

leather-key-chain-with-belt-loop.title: Leather Key Chain with Belt Loop
leather-key-chain-with-belt-loop.descriptionHtml: Skip stuffing an uncomfortable bulk in your pocket, and never lose your keys and accessories again. This high quality leather key chain is durable, fits most standard belts, and always looks fantastic.

executive-comfort-oxford.title: Executive Comfort Oxford
executive-comfort-oxford.descriptionHtml: Step into style and comfort with the Executive Comfort Oxford. Combining a German VibraStep Sole and genuine cow leather, these shoes are perfect for office and formal settings. They offer maximum comfort and durability, while the classic styling adds a touch of sophistication to any outfit.

bronco-handcrafted-wallet.title: Bronco | Men's Crazy Horse Leather Bifold Wallet
bronco-handcrafted-wallet.descriptionHtml:
The Bronco is a handcrafted bi-fold wallet made from genuine Crazy Horse cow leather, finished with a distinctive waxed, distressed look that develops a unique patina over time.Features:
100% genuine Crazy Horse cow leather
Bi-fold design
4 credit/debit card slots
2 hidden slots
1 large bill compartment
Measures approximately 3.5" x 4.5" when closed
The waxed Crazy Horse leather gives the Bronco a more rugged, vintage character than Kordovan's smoother leather wallets.

vouge-jewellery-case.title: Trinity Jewlery Case
vouge-jewellery-case.descriptionHtml: The Vouge Jewellery Case is the perfect solution for keeping your jewellery secure and organized. It is made from premium cow glazed leather, with a soft inner fabric to protect jewellery from scratches. The case features two compartments to store jewellery and trinkets, making it a sophisticated and practical choice.

imperial-keychain.title: Imperial Keychain
imperial-keychain.descriptionHtml: Unlock a stylish adventure with the Imperial Keychain! This sleek and durable keychain is crafted from very premium high grade leather, giving you a bold, sophisticated look that will never go out of style. Make a statement with the Imperial Keychain and take your accessorizing to the next level.

kordovans-affordable-cowboy-hat.title: KORDOVAN'S Black Stripe Leather Cowboy Hat
kordovans-affordable-cowboy-hat.descriptionHtml:
A plain black leather western hat with a contrast striped band around the crown — the simplest thing in the range and the easiest to wear with anything.

Lightweight genuine leather with a shaped brim, at the entry price of the range.

  • 100% genuine leather
  • Contrast striped band
  • Lightweight for long wear in heat
  • Sizes S to XL — measure around your head above the ears
  • Rs 4,800 · cash on delivery nationwide

tp-dblp-laptop-bag.title: DBLP Laptop Bag
tp-dblp-laptop-bag.descriptionHtml: The TP DBLP Laptop Bag is perfect for the office perople on the go. Crafted from pebbled top grain cow leather, it features two front pockets and a trolley handle slot for easy travelling. The main laptop pocket includes organizers for added convenience and efficiency. Stay stylish and organized with this must-have bag!

tp-millard-office-bag.title: Millard Office Bag
tp-millard-office-bag.descriptionHtml: Crafted from real, pebbled top grain leather, the TP Millard Office Bag elevates your style while providing practicality with three compartments, including a laptop compartment for up to 15 inches. The additional back zipper compartment and organizer in the first compartment make this bag perfect for your briefcase needs.

buffalo-bob-leather-belt.title: Buffalo Bob Leather Belt
buffalo-bob-leather-belt.descriptionHtml: Guaranteed for a lifetime of durable style, the Buffalo Bob Leather Belt is a top grain masterpiece. This premium leather belt will withstand any challenge with its rugged buffalo design. It's the perfect accessory for any adventure!

diana-cross-body-bag-pebbled-leather.title: Diana Cross-body Bag // Pebbled Leather
diana-cross-body-bag-pebbled-leather.descriptionHtml: Introducing the Diana Cross-body Bag - the ultimate combination of style and practicality. Made from top-quality pebbled top grain leather, this bag is perfect for both casual and formal occasions. Featuring three spacious compartments, it's the perfect everyday bag for any modern woman. Upgrade your carry game with this high-quality, versatile accessory.

diana-cross-body-bag-crazy-horse-leather.title: Diana Cross-body Bag // Crazy-Horse Leather
diana-cross-body-bag-crazy-horse-leather.descriptionHtml: Introducing the Diana Cross-body Bag - the ultimate combination of style and practicality. Made from top-quality crazy horse cow leather, this bag is perfect for both casual and formal occasions. Featuring three spacious compartments, it's the perfect everyday bag for any modern woman. Upgrade your carry game with this high-quality, versatile accessory.

the-seamless-stitch-less-wallet-brown.title: The Seamless | Stitch-less Slim Leather Card Wallet
the-seamless-stitch-less-wallet-brown.descriptionHtml:
No stitches. No seams. No bulk. The Seamless is a stitch-less single-compartment wallet folded from one piece of leather — card-sized, it holds up to 10 cards with cash tucked behind them, and ages remarkably over time.

  • Stitch-less, seamless single-piece construction
  • Holds up to 10 cards plus cash in one compartment
  • Card-sized — the slimmest carry we make
  • Ages beautifully with everyday use

Handcrafted in Pakistan and backed by our lifetime craftsmanship warranty — minimalism, done properly.
